articles.title: Travis Kelce invests in college sports as growing business empire fuels questions over Chiefs future
articles.standfirst: The Kansas City star is expanding into the NIL market as speculation continues over how much longer he plans to remain in the NFL
articles.summary: The Kansas City star is expanding into the NIL market as speculation continues over how much longer he plans to remain in the NFL
articles.body:
Travis Kelce is preparing for another season with the Kansas City Chiefs , but his latest business move is another reminder that his future is becoming increasingly important away from the football field as well.

Kelce has launched a new venture focused on college athletes and the rapidly expanding Name, Image and Likeness market, creating another business interest alongside the growing portfolio he has built during the latter stages of his NFL career.

The project is designed to help college athletes connect with brands and capitalize on endorsement opportunities, giving Kelce a foothold in an area that has transformed college sports in recent years.

The timing is notable because questions continue to surround how much longer the 37-year-old intends to play for Kansas City.

Kelce expands further beyond football

Kelce's involvement in NIL adds to a business empire that already stretches well beyond his role as Patrick Mahomes ' longtime target.

His New Heights podcast with brother Jason Kelce has become one of the most successful sports shows in the world, while he has also invested in several companies and entered professional sports ownership.

Earlier this year, Kelce joined the ownership group of the Cleveland Guardians , the MLB franchise he grew up supporting in Ohio.

Those ventures don't necessarily mean retirement is imminent, but they do show how deliberately Kelce has created opportunities that can continue long after his playing career ends.

Chiefs future remains under scrutiny

Kelce has returned for the 2026 season after Kansas City missed the playoffs last year, and he has publicly emphasized that he still believes he can contribute at a high level.

He has also spoken about wanting to become a stronger leader after admitting he wasn't satisfied with how the previous campaign ended.

That commitment suggests his attention remains firmly on football for now, despite the growing number of projects demanding his time away from the Chiefs .

Still, every new investment inevitably adds to speculation about when he might decide that his next chapter is ready to begin.

Kelce no longer needs football to define his public profile or financial future, which gives him a level of freedom most players don't have as retirement approaches.

His latest college sports venture doesn't confirm that the end is near, but it does make one thing increasingly clear: whenever Kelce finally walks away from Kansas City, he already has an extensive business empire waiting for him.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes’ ranking raises the biggest question in the NFL Top 100
articles.standfirst: Patrick Mahomes outside the NFL Top 10? The latest ranking has everyone talking.
articles.summary: Patrick Mahomes outside the NFL Top 10? The latest ranking has everyone talking.
articles.body:
P atrick Mahomes had missed only five games as an established full-time starter in the NFL before suffering a serious ACL and LCL ligament injury during Week 15 of last season against the Los Angeles Chargers. The setback represented the biggest physical challenge of his career for the Kansas City Chiefs quarterback, a future Hall of Famer, who had never previously dealt with an injury of that magnitude.

Although there were initial concerns that surgery could keep him sidelined for several weeks at the start of the season, Mahomes remains on a favorable timeline and is aiming to be ready for the season opener in Week 1 against the Broncos . Everything indicates he will not participate in the preseason as he continues his recovery process.

For years, Mahomes has been considered one of the best quarterbacks in the NFL, even after a slight decline in his offensive numbers in recent seasons. However, the latest edition of the NFL Top 100 rankings surprised many by reflecting a significant drop in the Kansas City star’s evaluation.

The list revealed the players ranked between No. 20 and No. 17 on Wednesday, placing Mahomes at No. 18 , behind Indianapolis Colts running back Jonathan Taylor . It is only the second time in his career that he has fallen outside the Top 10 and the first time since his rookie season.

Since he was not ranked during his second year, when he was the backup to Alex Smith , Mahomes had never finished outside the top 10. He was ranked No. 1 in the 2021 and 2023 editions, while also finishing inside the Top 5 in 2019, 2020, 2024, and 2025.

The quarterback is the fourth Chiefs player — and likely the final one — to appear on this year’s ranking. Before him, Creed Humphrey (No. 94) , Travis Kelce (No. 79) , and Chris Jones (No. 43) were included.

Although the drop in the rankings can spark debate, there are some arguments that support the decision. Mahomes’ touchdown rate has declined compared to his best seasons, and his overall statistics have not reached the dominant level he displayed from 2018 through 2022 .

Crisis in Kansas City? Andy Reid delivers worrying update as Chiefs injuries pile up

Still, names such as Josh Allen, Matthew Stafford, and surprisingly Drake Maye have yet to appear on the list, meaning all of them will finish ahead of Mahomes.

However, rankings should always be taken with caution. When a game is on the line and the ball is in a quarterback’s hands in the fourth quarter, few players inspire more confidence than Mahomes. Even after a season below his own standards, he remains the player Chiefs fans want leading their offense in the biggest moments.

articles.title: Who are the winningest coaches in NFL history? Andy Reid stands alone as the only active coach in the top five
articles.standfirst: Reid would need to coach in the NFL for at least five more seasons to become the coach with the most wins
articles.summary: Reid would need to coach in the NFL for at least five more seasons to become the coach with the most wins
articles.body:
There is no doubt that among active head coaches, Andy Reid is the winningest and most experienced entering the 2026 NFL season , boasting three Super Bowl wins with all of his titles and five of his six total appearances coming with Patrick Mahomes as his quarterback.

Reid is entering his 28th season as an NFL head coach, including 14 seasons in Philadelphia and now 14 in Kansas City, where he has endured only four losing seasons and secured playoff appearances in 20 of his 27 years , easily easier said than done.

Reid enters this campaign coming off his toughest year with the Chiefs (6-11) after achieving nine consecutive AFC West titles and playing in three straight Super Bowls.

Andy Reid Among the Winningest Coaches in NFL History

With his three Super Bowl rings, Reid trails only legendary skippers Chuck Noll (4 wins) and Bill Belichick (6 wins) among the most decorated champions in league history.

In terms of regular-season wins , he ranks fourth all-time with 279 victories , sitting behind only Bill Belichick (302) , George Halas (318) , and Don Shula (328) . To catch Shula, the legendary Dolphins coach, Reid would need to rack up at least 10 wins across roughly five more seasons.

Given that he has Mahomes under center, that milestone doesn't sound far-fetched at all, the real question is whether he wants to keep coaching for another five years. In the postseason , Reid is already the second winningest coach in NFL history with 28 total playoff victories (including 18 with Kansas City).

Among other active coaches, he is followed closely by John Harbaugh (24) , Mike McCarthy (22) , and Sean Payton (20) , all of whom look to pad their win totals this year.

The Chase: Where Active NFL Coaches Rank on the All-Time Wins List

Following Reid's 279 regular-season wins is Sean Payton with 184 (13th all-time) ; Payton has found his franchise quarterback in Bo Nix and could crack the top 10 with a 10-win season in Denver.

Right behind Payton is John Harbaugh with 180 wins (14th all-time) , who is entering his first year in New York with the Giants and could also push into the top 10 with an 11-win campaign.

Mike McCarthy follows with 174 wins (15th all-time) and takes over a new team in Pittsburgh, ironically marking a tight cluster of three consecutive veterans on the all-time list finding fresh starts.

Further down the active leaderboard, Sean McVay sits in fifth place among active coaches with 92 wins (50th all-time).

However, McVay has only nine years of head coaching experience and remains very young at just 40 years old, meaning if he maintains this incredible start to his career, we may well be talking about him in the same breath as Reid down the road.

articles.title: Jason Kelce is told he’s the second-favorite Kelce at Chiefs camp and Travis isn’t first
articles.standfirst: Jason came to Chiefs training camp to support his younger brother, only to hear a fan deliver an unexpected Kelce family ranking
articles.summary: Jason came to Chiefs training camp to support his younger brother, only to hear a fan deliver an unexpected Kelce family ranking
articles.body:
J ason Kelce came to Chiefs training camp to support his younger brother Travis, but one fan made sure the retired Eagles star left knowing exactly where he stands in her personal Kelce family rankings.

Jason was walking near fans at Chiefs camp when a woman spotted him and shouted a message that immediately caught his attention: “Jason! You’re our second favorite Kelce!”

Jason didn't stop to challenge the ranking. He simply cracked a small smile and kept walking, but the comment left one obvious question hanging in the air. If Jason is No. 2, who managed to beat him for the top spot?

Travis wasn't No. 1 either

The obvious answer might seem to be Travis. After all, Jason was visiting the home of the Chiefs, surrounded by fans of the team his younger brother has helped lead to multiple Super Bowl championships. But Travis wasn't No. 1 either.

That honor belonged to someone else.

The fan finished the joke with the name that made everything fall into place: Donna. “You’re our second favorite Kelce to Donna!” she shouted. That puts Mama Kelce at No. 1, Jason at No. 2 and, by process of elimination, Travis at No. 3 at his own training camp.

Jason's subtle smile suggested he understood exactly what had just happened. He came to Chiefs camp to show some brotherly support, only for a fan to remind him that when it comes to the Kelces, even Travis can apparently lose a home game.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes could secure the Chiefs’ future by renegotiating his $43.56 million contract
articles.standfirst: A potential financial adjustment could give Kansas City more room to strengthen the roster around its star quarterback
articles.summary: A potential financial adjustment could give Kansas City more room to strengthen the roster around its star quarterback
articles.body:
P atrick Mahomes has already given the Kansas City Chiefs one of the greatest quarterback careers in franchise history, but his contract could once again become part of the conversation surrounding the team's ability to build a championship roster.

Mahomes signed his famous 10-year extension with Kansas City in 2020, a deal that was originally worth up to $503 million and was designed to keep him under contract through the 2031 season.

Since then, the NFL's quarterback market has continued to rise, forcing the Chiefs to repeatedly adjust the financial structure of the deal to keep it competitive with newer contracts.

The latest discussion centres on whether another renegotiation could benefit both Mahomes and the Chiefs .

While the quarterback would not necessarily need to take a straightforward pay cut, restructuring the deal could potentially create additional salary-cap flexibility for Kansas City.

That could be particularly important as the Chiefs attempt to return to the Super Bowl picture following a disappointing 2025 campaign.

Mahomes remains the centerpiece of the franchise. However, the team needs quality players around him if it wants to challenge for another Lombardi Trophy, and allocating a huge portion of the salary cap to one player inevitably makes roster construction more difficult.

The situation is complicated by the fact that Mahomes ' contract was already considered team-friendly in some respects compared with the enormous deals subsequently handed to other elite quarterbacks.

Rather than asking Mahomes to sacrifice money outright, Kansas City could potentially convert portions of his salary into signing bonuses or restructure the agreement to move money between seasons.

Such moves can lower a player's immediate salary-cap charge while pushing more financial obligations into future years.

Why another Mahomes restructure could matter

The Chiefs have demonstrated before that they are willing to manipulate the quarterback's contract when necessary.

The objective would not simply be to create spending room for the sake of it. Kansas City would need to use any additional flexibility intelligently, particularly with several areas of the roster requiring attention.

A more manageable cap number for Mahomes could give general manager Brett Veach greater freedom to retain important veterans, add outside talent and strengthen the supporting cast around the quarterback.

That matters because Mahomes ' success has historically been tied to the quality of the roster surrounding him. His ability to extend plays and produce spectacular moments is obvious, but even an elite quarterback needs protection, reliable receivers and a strong defense to compete consistently.

The Chiefs also have to think beyond one season. Restructuring a contract can provide immediate relief, but it does not eliminate the money owed to the player. In many cases, it simply changes when that money counts against the salary cap.

That means Kansas City would have to balance short-term ambition with its long-term financial health.

Mahomes , meanwhile, has already shown that he understands the importance of building a competitive team. His enormous contract has been repeatedly discussed in the context of the Chiefs' roster-building strategy, particularly as quarterback salaries across the NFL continue to climb.

There is therefore a potential argument for another adjustment if it gives Kansas City a realistic opportunity to add a difference-maker.

The Chiefs are not necessarily facing a situation where Mahomes must personally give up tens of millions of dollars. Instead, the more realistic scenario would involve restructuring the existing agreement in a way that changes the timing of his cap charges.

For Kansas City, that could be the difference between having limited flexibility and being able to make one significant move.

Ultimately, however, the Chiefs ' future cannot depend entirely on contract gymnastics. They must identify the right players to sign, draft effectively and avoid allowing short-term cap relief to create larger problems later.

Mahomes ' contract is enormous, but so is the value he provides. If another restructuring can give the Chiefs the resources to surround him with a stronger roster without creating an unsustainable financial burden, it could be an attractive option for both sides.

The quarterback has already helped establish Kansas City as one of the NFL's premier teams. The next challenge is ensuring that the financial structure surrounding him allows the franchise to remain competitive for years to come.

articles.title: Xavier Worthy is at it again at Chiefs training camp as he suddenly heads back to his car for his PS5
articles.standfirst: Xavier Worthy doesn't need anyone's permission to do whatever he wants before practice
articles.summary: Xavier Worthy doesn't need anyone's permission to do whatever he wants before practice
articles.body:
Kansas City Chiefs wide receiver Xavier Worthy has had his share of controversial moments during his NFL career. He has faced punishment and fines for celebrations considered prohibited or gestures toward opponents, while some of his key catches in important games have sparked online debate over whether the ball touched the ground before he had control. His most serious controversy came when he was arrested on an assault charge involving a family or household member and allegedly impeding breathing. The case was later dropped after prosecutors declined to pursue charges.

And once again, Worthy did exactly what he wanted just before the Chiefs began another training camp practice ahead of the NFL preseason . As he was walking toward the field, something apparently crossed his mind and he suddenly decided to turn around and head back to his car.

Worthy returns with something unexpected

He grabbed the PS5 he had inside and walked back carrying it, only to give it away to a fan. A fan who certainly wasn't expecting to go home with a PlayStation 5, much less one that a Kansas City Chiefs player may have played himself.

It was a moment filled with happiness, not only for the fan. Surely, the satisfaction of making someone happy, especially one of your own fans can feel pretty good for Xavier, too . Or at least that's what it looked like from the smile on his face.

If doing something good can make you feel this great, why not learn to control the outbursts too, especially when they can lead to allegations involving physical violence?

That's exactly what the wide receiver has to take care of if he wants to focus completely on football, contribute everything he knows he can bring to the Chiefs and continue making his name in the NFL .

On the field, Worthy showed again last season why Kansas City has so much invested in his talent . His speed remained one of the most dangerous weapons in the Chiefs offense, even as injuries and inconsistency affected parts of his season.

But his year also showed the contrast that continues to follow him : spectacular athletic ability on one side and moments away from the football that can become bigger stories than anything he does with the ball in his hands.

This time, however, there was no fine, no controversial celebration and no trouble waiting for him when Worthy decided to do his own thing. He simply turned around, went back to his car and came back carrying a PS5 that was about to make someone's day. Maybe this is the kind of Xavier Worthy “doing whatever he wants” that Chiefs fans wouldn't mind seeing a lot more often.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes leaves Chiefs practice on a speeding cart, but it's not what it might seem
articles.standfirst: The scene looked concerning until Mahomes gave it away
articles.summary: The scene looked concerning until Mahomes gave it away
articles.body:
S eeing Patrick Mahomes leave a Kansas City Chiefs practice on a cart moving at a pretty good speed is enough to make some fans look twice. Especially right now. The quarterback is coming back from the serious knee injury that ended his 2025 season, so practically anything involving Mahomes, his legs and a cart can immediately raise questions.

But what happened Thursday morning in St. Joseph appears far less dramatic than the first few seconds of the video might suggest. Mahomes wasn't being rushed away in obvious distress. He was sitting calmly in the passenger seat and even waved to fans as the cart made its way past them. More importantly, the Chiefs had already wrapped up their 18th and final full-team training camp practice at Missouri Western State University.

So yes, Mahomes left Chiefs practice on a cart that was moving fast that part really happened. But the context changes everything. There has been no credible report that the quarterback suffered a new injury Thursday or that his ride away from the field was connected to a medical emergency. His relaxed body language and interaction with the fans certainly didn't make it look like one either.

The timing matters even more because Mahomes has been under a microscope throughout training camp. He underwent surgery after tearing the ACL and LCL in his left knee in December, but was fully cleared by his surgeon for football activities before camp began. Since then, Kansas City has carefully watched his progression as he works toward being ready for the regular season.

Th e Chiefs held a lighter practice in shells after three consecutive days in full pads, and Mahomes and Travis Kelce were among the veterans making their final walk down the familiar hill at St. Joseph as Kansas City officially brought another training camp to an end.

Mahomes also won't play Saturday against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers, but that decision wasn't announced as the result of something happening to him on Thursday . Andy Reid said Justin Fields will start, followed by Garrett Nussmeier and Chris Oladokun, while Mahomes sits out. The Chiefs do have several players dealing with injuries as camp ends, but Mahomes was not among the new injury concerns Reid detailed Thursday.

Sometimes a video needs only a few seconds to make something look much more dramatic than it really is. A cart was moving quickly away from Chiefs practice with Patrick Mahomes sitting inside, and given everything he has been through with his knee, it's easy to understand why that image might get attention.

But what happened Thursday morning in St. Joseph appears far less dramatic than the first few seconds of the video might suggest. Mahomes wasn't being rushed away in obvious distress. He was sitting calmly in the passenger seat and even waved to fans as the cart made its way past them. More importantly, the Chiefs had already wrapped up their 18th and final full-team training camp practice at Missouri Western State University.

So yes, Mahomes left Chiefs practice on a cart that was moving fast that part really happened. But the context changes everything. There has been no credible report that the quarterback suffered a new injury Thursday or that his ride away from the field was connected to a medical emergency. His relaxed body language and interaction with the fans certainly didn't make it look like one either.

The timing matters even more because Mahomes has been under a microscope throughout training camp. He underwent surgery after tearing the ACL and LCL in his left knee in December, but was fully cleared by his surgeon for football activities before camp began. Since then, Kansas City has carefully watched his progression as he works toward being ready for the regular season.

Th e Chiefs held a lighter practice in shells after three consecutive days in full pads, and Mahomes and Travis Kelce were among the veterans making their final walk down the familiar hill at St. Joseph as Kansas City officially brought another training camp to an end.

Mahomes also won't play Saturday against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers, but that decision wasn't announced as the result of something happening to him on Thursday . Andy Reid said Justin Fields will start, followed by Garrett Nussmeier and Chris Oladokun, while Mahomes sits out. The Chiefs do have several players dealing with injuries as camp ends, but Mahomes was not among the new injury concerns Reid detailed Thursday.

Sometimes a video needs only a few seconds to make something look much more dramatic than it really is. A cart was moving quickly away from Chiefs practice with Patrick Mahomes sitting inside, and given everything he has been through with his knee, it's easy to understand why that image might get attention.

articles.title: The shocking price and secret detail hidden inside Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce’s wedding rings
articles.standfirst: Their rings aren't identical, but the design choices make them more meaningful
articles.summary: Their rings aren't identical, but the design choices make them more meaningful
articles.body:
Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce didn't walk away from their wedding wearing identical rings, but that may be exactly the point.

More than a month after the couple married at Madison Square Garden on July 3, clearer photographs of their wedding bands have given jewelry experts a chance to examine the details. Their conclusion is that the rings appear to tell the same story without looking like copies of one another.

Swift wears a slim, curved yellow-gold band accented with diamonds, while Kelce’s ring is broader and appears to feature engraved detailing. The connection comes through the shared metal, craftsmanship and subtle design choices rather than matching silhouettes.

That approach, according to The Clear Cut founder and CEO Olivia Landau , has become increasingly popular among couples who want their rings to feel individual but still unmistakably linked.

“Couples are moving away from perfectly matching wedding bands and instead choosing rings that feel connected without being identical, through a shared metal, finish, engraving, or other design element,” Landau told Elle Magazine.

Swift’s curved band carries symbolic message

The most distinctive feature of Swift ’s ring is its contour. Rather than sitting straight beside her engagement ring, the wedding band curves around it, allowing the two pieces to fit together as a single design.

Jeweler Logan Hollowell believes that carries an especially romantic meaning.

“A contoured band allows the wedding ring to become part of the engagement ring’s design story rather than simply sitting beside it,” Hollowell told Page Six.

“There is something incredibly romantic about it. The wedding band is shaped specifically to meet another ring. On its own it has one silhouette, but when the two pieces come together, they create something entirely new.”

The diamonds appear to form a partial or half eternity band, a style traditionally associated with lasting commitment.

“An eternity band has always carried this beautiful symbolism of continuity and enduring love,” Hollowell added.

The design also has a practical advantage. Because the stones don't necessarily extend around the entire underside of the finger, they may be better protected during everyday wear, potentially useful for Swift , who frequently plays guitar and piano.

Kelce’s ring may contain details fans can't see

Kelce ’s band takes a heavier, simpler approach, but experts believe its yellow gold and apparent engraving connect it to his wife’s jewelry.

The most meaningful details, however, may never be visible in photographs.

“People want their wedding bands to feel uniquely theirs, whether that means a hidden engraving, a meaningful motif, a significant date, or a design detail only the couple understands,” Landau said.

That possibility feels particularly fitting for Swift , whose music and public storytelling have long included hidden references, symbols and personal callbacks.

As Landau put it, the rings appear “complementary rather than matching, timeless but highly personal, and designed to tell a story beyond what you can immediately see.”

The bands may not look alike, but the deeper message, jewelers believe, is that they were never supposed to.

articles.title: Why Andy Reid is still keeping Patrick Mahomes on the bench
articles.standfirst: The Chiefs aren’t taking any chances with one of their biggest assets
articles.summary: The Chiefs aren’t taking any chances with one of their biggest assets
articles.body:
Sometimes being a coach means looking beyond what is obvious and anticipating what could happen next. One of the hardest parts of the job is putting everything into perspective and weighing the risks before making the best decision for the players and the team.

Earlier this month, Andy Reid admitted he was unsure whether Patrick Mahomes would see any preseason action . Now, it appears the Chiefs have made their decision and will keep their star quarterback on the sidelines.

Reid is thinking beyond the preseason

There is plenty to question about Reid’s decision to keep Mahomes out, but the reality behind it goes beyond what the quarterback may want or what fans are demanding. Reid remains non-committal about Mahomes’ availability for the regular-season opener against the Denver Broncos on September 14.

Since Patrick was injured, he has been counting down the days until his official return to the team . He has even used clock emojis in his Instagram posts, seemingly counting down to his return as the Chiefs’ quarterback . And while everything suggests his recovery is going well, Reid still believes it is not the right time for Mahomes to return to the field.

The Chiefs are preparing for every scenario

Behind the official explanation, Reid remains optimistic about Mahomes’ recovery, saying that he is doing great and that the team is taking things day by day. Patrick may already feel ready to return, but t here is little reason to take that risk this early, with the regular season still ahead.

Justin Fields will start at quarterback for the Chiefs, and Reid said he plans to play him into the second quarter. Garrett Nussmeier and Chris Oladokun will be the other quarterbacks for Kansas City . That also suggests Reid is preparing for a possible scenario in which Mahomes is not ready to start the regular season . All of his quarterbacks need to be prepared for any situation.

The Chiefs’ success this season largely hinges on Mahomes’ health. While Reid remains hopeful, he is also being cautious and making sure Mahomes is fully ready before returning to full action.

Even with the anxiety surrounding his return, the reality is that the Chiefs need to take this step by step and remember that Mahomes’ injury was not just a simple twist . The confidence is not only about his physical condition, which appears to be under control. His mental readiness also matters , and that is where things can change when going from practice to a real game.

articles.title: Taylor Swift’s ex-boyfriend is placed on Russia’s most-wanted list
articles.standfirst: A Kennedy is now wanted by Russia over his time fighting in Ukraine
articles.summary: A Kennedy is now wanted by Russia over his time fighting in Ukraine
articles.body:
From Taylor Swift’s Kennedy era to Russia’s international wanted list, Conor Kennedy is making headlines for a very different reason .

Taylor Swift fans may remember Conor Kennedy as the Kennedy heir who briefly captured the singer’s attention in 2012 . More than a decade later, his name is back in the headlines, but this time for a reason far removed from his famous romance with Swift.

Their short-lived romance became part of Swift’s 2012 era

The couple’s paths crossed quickly. Swift and Conor were first spotted together in early July 2012, but their relationship ended by October of that same year. Before their romance, Swift had already become close to Conor’s grandmother, Ethel Kennedy , and was reportedly starstruck when she met the Kennedy family member.

Swift even drew inspiration from the family for her music . Her connection to Ethel Kennedy became part of the story behind Starlight , a track from her 2012 album Red that imagines a young romance between Ethel and her late husband, Robert F. Kennedy.

Conor’s name is now making headlines for a completely different reason

Conor, meanwhile, has taken a very different path since those days. The 32-year-old lawyer has been placed on Russia’s international wanted list and accused of acting as a mercenary while defending Ukraine against Russia in the countries’ ongoing conflict, according to Russian state media outlet TASS.

The charge is reportedly connected to a secret trip Conor made to Ukraine in 2022 . He later detailed the experience in an Instagram post published that October.

Conor, the son of Robert F. Kennedy Jr. and his late ex-wife Mary Richardson Kennedy, described his experience as a volunteer soldier. After spending two and a half months in Ukraine, he returned to the United States and resumed his law studies at Georgetown University.

If arrested , Conor could face a seven- to 10-year prison sentence in Russia over the charge.

More than a decade after his high-profile relationship with Swift, Conor has also moved on in his personal life. He is now engaged to Brazilian singer Giulia Be.

articles.title: Taylor Swift clashes with Jason Kelce as she steps into her fun aunt era
articles.standfirst: Taylor may be taking her role as the fun aunt seriously, but Jason Kelce is not making it easy
articles.summary: Taylor may be taking her role as the fun aunt seriously, but Jason Kelce is not making it easy
articles.body:
They say great power comes with great responsibility, and everything points to Swift being an important figure in the lives of Jason and Kylie Kelce’s daughters. Swift’s different eras have marked major moments in her life, and this time is no different as she embraces what it means to be the fun aunt for a very relatable reason revealed by Kylie.

Taylor’s cat influence is already working

Swift is well known for her love of cats, and that passion appears to be rubbing off on her nieces , despite Kylie being more of a dog person. Swift’s cats, Meredith Grey, Olivia Benson and Benjamin Button, have become favorite companions for Wyatt, Elliotte, Bennett and Finnley.

Kylie explained on an episode of her Not Gonna Lie podcast that she grew up in a home with both cats and dogs . Now, her children are exposed to cats through important influences in their lives, with Aunt Taylor being a major one . The problem starts when they return home and realize there are no cats waiting for them.

Kylie said she has been trying to convince Jason that there is a need for a cat in their home, but the former NFL star has not been willing to listen because he is allergic to feline hair.

Jason Kelce is fighting back

That could make the aunt and uncle’s house the fun house , especially if that is where the girls can spend time with cats and e njoy the experience they cannot have at home.

The situation becomes even more complicated because Jason is not a cat person . The Philadelphia Eagles alum’s family already includes Freddie, a German shepherd, and Nessie, an Irish wolfhound. He previously admitted that he told his daughters cats were poisonous in an attempt to make them lose interest.

During a 2024 episode of his and brother Travis Kelce’s New Heights podcast, J ason joked that he told his daughters the government would take them away if they had a cat because cats were so lethal they could kill them . He explained that the lie was his way of avoiding having another animal in the house while m aking the girls afraid of cats.

Jason also acknowledged that he needed to get his kids on his side because otherwise he would be fighting a losing battle . He does not want another animal in the house, especially after his dogs have already ruined the furniture.

The battle for a Kelce family cat continues

The battle is far from over, and Taylor’s influence may prove stronger than Jason’s efforts . With the girls already going crazy over cats, the fun aunt could be winning the feline battle.

Swift previously revealed during her 2025 appearance on New Heights that once she got the kids around cats, her goal was to prove they were not poisonous . Her strategy was simple: introduce them to Benjamin Button, her Ragdoll cat, who lets people hold him like a baby.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes had someone unexpected beside him during the loneliest part of his recovery
articles.standfirst: The Chiefs quarterback wasn't the only NFL star fighting his way back from major knee surgery, and a simple message turned into something neither player expected
articles.summary: The Chiefs quarterback wasn't the only NFL star fighting his way back from major knee surgery, and a simple message turned into something neither player expected
articles.body:
Less than 24 hours before undergoing major knee surgery of his own, Zach Ertz picked up his phone and sent Patrick Mahomes a message.

He had just watched the Kansas City Chiefs quarterback suffer a devastating non-contact knee injury against the Los Angeles Chargers. Ertz knew immediately that Mahomes was about to enter a world he understood all too well.

The veteran tight end had already been through an ACL recovery earlier in his career. Now, after suffering another serious knee injury just a week before Mahomes, he was about to do it again.

So Ertz sent Mahomes a simple message.

"It's a lonely road ahead," he told him, while making sure Mahomes knew he would be there if he needed him. Neither man could have known how important those words would become.

Mahomes and Ertz suddenly had each other

The timing was remarkable.

Mahomes and Ertz underwent ACL and LCL repair surgeries on Dec. 15. They weren't teammates and didn't even rehab together, but suddenly they were going through almost exactly the same physical and emotional battle at the same time.

They began texting. How is rehab going? What did you work on today? How are you getting through it?

The messages weren't about football fame, Super Bowls or statistics. They were two injured players trying to make it through days when progress could feel almost invisible.

For Mahomes, that mattered.

The Chiefs quarterback later admitted that rehab can become incredibly lonely because so much of the work is done by yourself. Ertz gave him someone else to measure himself against and another outlet for the competitive drive that normally has an entire football field to feed it.

For Ertz, Mahomes provided something equally valuable: proof that it was possible to keep pushing.

One Mahomes video changed something for Ertz

Knee rehabilitation doesn't always reward effort immediately.

Ertz explained that an athlete can spend days working on an exercise without being able to add even a pound because range of motion simply isn't there yet. For players accustomed to measuring improvement constantly, that can become mentally exhausting.

At one point, Ertz was hesitant to attempt crossover steps. Then he saw Mahomes.

A video showed the Chiefs quarterback already performing the movement as he dropped back to pass . Watching Mahomes attack that stage of his recovery gave Ertz the confidence to push himself, too.

"I think he just encouraged me," Ertz told The Athletic, pointing specifically to how aggressively Mahomes approached his rehabilitation. But this wasn't a one-way relationship.

Ertz had something Mahomes needed, too

At another point in the process, Mahomes was having difficulty pushing off his big toe while running. Ertz knew the feeling because he had experienced the same problem.

So instead of simply sending encouragement, he sent Mahomes an exercise and a video showing something that had worked for him. That small exchange perhaps explains their relationship better than anything else.

They weren't just telling each other everything would be OK. They understood what the other was feeling because, in many cases, they had felt it themselves.

When one found something that worked, he shared it. When one moved forward, the other saw what might be possible.

And when Mahomes was finally cleared to participate fully in Chiefs training camp barely more than seven months after surgery, Ertz was watching. "Bro, you're killing it," he texted him.

Mahomes barely looks like he was injured

Mahomes' progress has become increasingly visible.

After tearing the ACL and LCL in his left knee in December, the three-time Super Bowl champion worked his way back to full participation at training camp in late July, an extraordinary milestone given the severity of the injury.

Ertz said that when he watched Mahomes during offseason work, there was almost nothing in his movement that suggested what he had gone through.

The knee brace was the giveaway. Without it, Ertz said, Mahomes looked like Mahomes. That comeback carries even more meaning for Ertz because his own journey isn't finished.

At 35, the veteran tight end is training at Stanford while waiting for another NFL opportunity. He says GPS data has his top speed back to 99 percent of what it was before the injury, while other testing has shown encouraging improvements in his explosiveness and strength.

Ertz believes he can still help an NFL team. He isn't asking to be promised a starting job or a specific role. He just wants the opportunity to compete.

And somewhere along a recovery that began with uncertainty about whether he had played his final NFL snap, he found an unlikely person helping him believe that was still possible. Mahomes did the same.

Two players in different places, working for different teams and facing different futures somehow ended up sharing the same difficult road. Ertz's first message to Mahomes turned out to be right. Rehab could be lonely. They just didn't have to go through it alone.

articles.title: Move over, Patrick! Brittany Mahomes shows off her toned physique in a new Adidas campaign
articles.standfirst: The former soccer player and Kansas City Current co-owner puts her athletic background front and center in a stylish new collaboration
articles.summary: The former soccer player and Kansas City Current co-owner puts her athletic background front and center in a stylish new collaboration
articles.body:
B rittany Mahomes is proving that the Mahomes family’s connection with Adidas extends well beyond her husband.

While Kansas City Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes continues preparations for the upcoming NFL season, Brittany has stepped into the spotlight herself, showcasing her athletic background in a new Adidas campaign that combines training gear with a fashion-focused aesthetic.

The former soccer player shared a series of photographs on Instagram featuring different Adidas outfits while working out in a gym.

The campaign was produced in collaboration with Dick’s Sporting Goods, giving Brittany another opportunity to connect her personal fitness interests with one of the world’s biggest sportswear brands.

articles.title: “Dragged off the pitch”: Andy Reid reveals why he had to force Travis Kelce to stop training
articles.standfirst: The Chiefs coach says his veteran tight end was working so relentlessly that Kansas City’s staff had to intervene and make him rest
articles.summary: The Chiefs coach says his veteran tight end was working so relentlessly that Kansas City’s staff had to intervene and make him rest
articles.body:
T ravis Kelce is heading into his 14th NFL season at an age when most players are already long removed from the grind of training camp.

Yet, according to Kansas City Chiefs head coach Andy Reid , the veteran tight end has been so determined to keep working that coaches have actually had to step in and make him stop.

As Kansas City brought its 2026 training camp to a close on August 20, Reid highlighted Kelce's remarkable approach to preparation.

Rather than needing encouragement to increase his workload, the 36-year-old apparently required the opposite.

“You have examples like Kelce ; he’s the oldest guy on the team and came out every day and worked to where you had to yank him out of there to give him a breather,” Reid said to reporters after practice.

The comment offers a revealing picture of Kelce's mindset as he prepares for another season with the Chiefs . He is the oldest player on the roster, but Reid's description suggests that age has not diminished his desire to compete.

Reports from the conclusion of camp have similarly portrayed Kelce as one of the veterans setting the tone for a relatively young Kansas City roster.

Linebacker Nick Bolton was particularly impressed by the example being set by the future Hall of Famer.

“There’s no excuses when you have the old guy out there running routes and stuff like that,” Bolton said. ” Been fun to watch [Kelce] work.”

That mentality could be particularly important for the Chiefs as they attempt to rebound from a disappointing 2025 campaign.

Kelce and quarterback Patrick Mahomes were held out of Kansas City's preseason opener against the Los Angeles Rams on August 15, a 20-12 defeat, as the coaching staff concentrated on evaluating younger players.

But sitting out a preseason game clearly did not mean Kelce was easing off during camp.

Kelce's workload comes against a backdrop of retirement questions

The intensity is especially notable because Kelce's future has been one of the recurring storylines surrounding the Chiefs over the past couple of seasons.

At 36, he is entering his 14th NFL campaign, and there have been multiple moments when retirement appeared to be a realistic possibility.

Reid has repeatedly acknowledged that Kelce cannot continue playing indefinitely while simultaneously expressing his desire to see the tight end remain in Kansas City .

“You hope he plays forever, but that’s probably not gonna happen to any of us.” Reid said. “So whenever he decides to hang it up, he’s built a great legacy here. And if he decides this is it, it’s it. If not, more power to him.”

Kelce , however, made it clear during the offseason that he still believed he had unfinished business.

“I know I’m getting older, but at the same time I still feel like I got a lot that I can prove in this league. It really wasn’t that hard of a decision for me.” Travis said.

“Last year I think I failed especially in that last game, in being a leader and being the one that can step up and make plays.”

His recent work in camp appears to back up that declaration.

The statistics from the previous two seasons do provide some reason for questions about how much longer Kelce can operate at his peak. He recorded 823 receiving yards and three touchdowns in 2024, followed by 851 yards and five touchdowns in 2025.

The latter represented a modest improvement, but it was still his third consecutive season below 1,000 yards after he had surpassed that mark seven years in a row from 2016 through 2022.

Even so, Kelce remained heavily involved in Kansas City's offense last season, playing all 17 games and leading the Chiefs in receptions, receiving yards and receiving touchdowns.

That combination, declining production but an undiminished work ethic, makes the upcoming season particularly intriguing.

Kelce is not being asked to prove that he can become the player he was during his statistical peak. Instead, the challenge is whether his experience, football intelligence and connection with Mahomes can continue to make him a central part of the Chiefs ' offense.

The relationship between Kelce and Mahomes will again be crucial. The pair have developed one of the NFL's most productive quarterback-tight end partnerships, and Mahomes' return from his 2025 injury adds another layer to Kansas City's preparations.

For Kelce, meanwhile, the immediate message from Reid is simple: sometimes the biggest challenge is knowing when to stop.

At an age when recovery is increasingly important, having to be “yank[ed]” from practice is hardly a criticism. If anything, it demonstrates how seriously Kelce is approaching what could be one of the final chapters of his extraordinary career.

Kansas City will ultimately need to balance that enthusiasm with preservation. The Chiefs do not need Kelce to win training-camp competitions. They need him healthy and productive when the regular season arrives.

For now, though, Reid's comments suggest the veteran tight end has no intention of coasting toward the finish line.

articles.title: Leaving Travis behind? Taylor Swift swaps her newlywed life for a girls' night out with Dakota Johnson
articles.standfirst: The pop superstar reportedly reunited with her longtime friend in Los Angeles weeks after marrying Travis Kelce
articles.summary: The pop superstar reportedly reunited with her longtime friend in Los Angeles weeks after marrying Travis Kelce
articles.body:
T aylor Swift may have only recently entered married life, but that has not stopped the pop superstar from making time for one of her closest friends.

Swift reportedly enjoyed a low-key girls' night out with actress Dakota Johnson in Los Angeles, marking a reunion between the longtime friends less than two months after Swift married NFL star Travis Kelce .

According to reports, the pair spent time at the exclusive Bird Streets Club, a members-only hotspot in the Hollywood Hills area.

Neither Swift nor Johnson was photographed directly during the outing, although a picture shared online appeared to show a member of Swift's security team outside the venue.

The timing of the meeting has naturally attracted attention, particularly because Johnson has recently been at the center of breakup reports.

People reported earlier this week that Johnson and musician Tucker Pillsbury , better known by his stage name Role Model, had ended their relationship. A source told the publication that the pair had split “a while ago,” although neither Johnson nor Pillsbury has publicly confirmed the details.

Swift and Johnson's latest reunion therefore comes at an interesting moment for the actress, who has maintained a relatively private approach to her personal life.

Taylor Swift and Dakota Johnson have remained close for years

The friendship between Swift and Johnson is not a new development.

The two stars have been connected for years and were last publicly spotted together in May 2025, when they reportedly had dinner at New York City's Via Carota alongside Swift's brother Austin and Johnson's brother Jesse.

Their friendship also produced one of the more memorable celebrity moments during Johnson's 2024 “Saturday Night Live” hosting appearance.

During her opening monologue, Johnson looked toward Swift in the audience while joking about the singer's enormous influence. “And look who’s sitting right behind me,” she said, before adding, “[It’s] crazy to be standing so close to someone who would become the most powerful person in America.”

The friendship has continued despite both women navigating major changes in their personal lives.

For Swift , one of the biggest changes came just weeks ago when she and Kelce finally became husband and wife.

The couple tied the knot at Madison Square Garden in New York City on July 3. Swift's representative confirmed the marriage, with comedian Adam Sandler officiating the ceremony. Swift's brother Austin served as her “Man of Honor,” while Kelce's brother Jason was his best man.

The wedding itself was anything but understated. The couple celebrated at the iconic arena in front of a huge gathering of family, friends and celebrity guests, while screens outside Madison Square Garden displayed the message “JUST&T MARRIED!”

Johnson was among the high-profile guests. She attended the celebration in a striking black halter-neck gown with a thigh-high slit, completing the look with black peep-toe heels.

That makes her reported reunion with Swift particularly notable. Rather than disappearing completely into newlywed life, Swift appears to be maintaining the friendships that have been important to her for years.

Johnson's reported split adds another layer to the reunion

Johnson's reported breakup with Role Model is also fresh in the public conversation.

The actress and Pillsbury were first linked in December 2025 after being seen together in Los Angeles.

Their relationship gradually became more public during 2026, including appearances together and a creative collaboration on Pillsbury's music. Johnson provided a spoken-word contribution to his song “Love I You,” which appeared on his album Chuck Timely & the Hourglass.

Pillsbury had previously spoken positively about bringing Johnson into the recording process, explaining that she came to the studio and ended up contributing to the track.

Despite that apparent closeness, reports now say the relationship has ended.

Swift's reported night out with Johnson could therefore simply be what longtime friends do: spend time together when one of them is going through a major transition.

It also comes as Swift herself has been undergoing a dramatically different transition following her wedding. After years of intense public attention surrounding her relationship with Kelce, the singer is now navigating life as a newlywed while continuing to balance her career and personal relationships.

Interestingly, Swift has also recently been seen outside the United States. She attended the August 15 wedding of friends Oli Jacobs and Laura Sisk in Gloucestershire, where she debuted a noticeably shorter hairstyle with side-swept bangs.

Her latest Los Angeles outing suggests that, despite the enormous attention surrounding her marriage, Swift still values ordinary moments with her inner circle.

And with Johnson reportedly coming out of a relationship of her own, the timing of their girls' night may have given the two friends plenty to catch up on.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes provides a crucial update on his injury ahead of the Chiefs' season opener
articles.standfirst: Kansas City’s star quarterback remains confident he can return in time for Week 1 despite sitting out the preseason
articles.summary: Kansas City’s star quarterback remains confident he can return in time for Week 1 despite sitting out the preseason
articles.body:
P atrick Mahomes provides a crucial update on his injury ahead of the Chiefs ' season opener

Kansas City ’s star quarterback remains confident he can return in time for Week 1 despite sitting out the preseason

Patrick Mahomes has offered Kansas City Chiefs fans another encouraging update on his recovery, insisting that he remains on course to return for the regular-season opener after suffering a serious knee injury last season.

Mahomes watched from the sideline as the Chiefs faced the Tampa Bay Buccaneers in their second preseason game on Saturday, August 22.

Although the quarterback had hoped to get some game action, Kansas City again opted for caution as he continues working his way back from torn ligaments in his left knee.

During the broadcast with Trent Green , Mahomes explained that he wanted to play against Tampa Bay but that the decision was ultimately out of his hands.

More importantly, he indicated that he hopes to get onto the field in the Chiefs ' final preseason contest next week.

Mahomes also made his confidence in his Week 1 status clear, saying he is “extremely confident” that he can be ready for the regular-season opener and adding, “We’re trending that direction.”

That represents a significant checkpoint in what has been a lengthy rehabilitation.

Mahomes suffered tears to both his ACL and LCL in his left knee during Kansas City's December 2025 loss to the Los Angeles Chargers .

He underwent surgery the following day and entered the offseason facing a recovery timeline that made his availability for the beginning of the 2026 campaign a major question.

Mahomes is still targeting the Broncos game

The Chiefs have been careful not to rush their franchise quarterback. Mahomes was cleared for football activities before training camp and has since participated in practice, including work with the first-team offense. However, the coaching staff has avoided putting him into preseason games so far.

That approach continued against Tampa Bay, where Justin Fields received the start, followed by Garrett Nussmeier and Chris Oladokun . Mahomes therefore has not played in either of Kansas City's first two preseason contests.

Head coach Andy Reid has repeatedly emphasized that the priority is having Mahomes healthy when the games actually matter.

Recent reporting has indicated that there has been no significant setback in his recovery and that he remains on track for Week 1. ESPN's Adam Schefter and NFL Network's Ian Rapoport have both reported that Mahomes is expected to be ready for the opener.

Mahomes ' own comments have followed that same line. Earlier in the offseason, he said his goal was to be ready for Week 1 and acknowledged that the final decision would belong to the medical and coaching staffs.

That opener carries additional significance because Kansas City will face the Denver Broncos , the team that won the AFC West while the Chiefs missed the playoffs in 2025. Mahomes has already made clear that he wants to be on the field for that matchup.

The next preseason game could therefore become an important test. If Reid decides Mahomes is ready for limited action, even a brief appearance would give the Chiefs another opportunity to evaluate his movement, mobility and comfort before the regular season.

For now, though, Kansas City appears to be prioritizing the bigger picture. Mahomes does not need to prove anything in August, particularly after spending months recovering from a major knee injury.

The encouraging part is that the quarterback himself believes the rehabilitation is progressing exactly as hoped.

With Week 1 approaching, his latest update suggests the Chiefs' biggest question is no longer whether Mahomes can return at all, but precisely when Reid and the medical team will decide that he is ready to take the final step.

articles.title: Can the Chiefs avoid disaster? Andy Reid reacts to latest preseason injury setback
articles.standfirst: Alohi Gilman’s absence adds pressure to a Kansas City secondary still searching for stability
articles.summary: Alohi Gilman’s absence adds pressure to a Kansas City secondary still searching for stability
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs entered the final stages of the preseason focused on evaluating their roster and preparing for another Super Bowl push, but Andy Reid ’s plans have been complicated by another defensive injury concern.

Safety Alohi Gilman was ruled out shortly before Saturday’s preseason matchup against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers after suffering a back issue during warmups.

The setback came at an important time for Kansas City , with roster cuts approaching and players competing for limited spots on the 53-man roster.

The Chiefs were already managing several injuries on defense, and Gilman ’s absence created another challenge for a secondary that is relying on a mix of experienced veterans and younger players heading into the 2026 season.

Reid explained after the game that Gilman ’s issue appeared suddenly before kickoff.

“Alohi in warm-ups had some low back spasms, so he didn’t play,” Reid said. “Then Tyreke Smith tweaked his right hamstring. Not sure how bad that is, but it was bad enough to where he couldn’t continue.”

Gilman role makes injury a concern

While preseason injuries are common, Gilman ’s situation carries extra importance because of the role Kansas City expected him to play this season.

The former Notre Dame standout signed with the Chiefs in March after spending most of his NFL career with the Los Angeles Chargers . Selected in the sixth round of the 2020 NFL Draft, Gilman developed into a dependable safety with valuable experience in coverage and run support.

He appeared in 17 games last season, recording 90 tackles, nine passes defended, one forced fumble and one defensive touchdown. Across his career, Gilman has registered 290 tackles, five interceptions, 27 passes defended and five forced fumbles.

Kansas City brought him in to add leadership and stability following changes in the secondary, making his absence more significant as the team continues to evaluate its defensive depth.

The Chiefs were already without safety Chamarri Conner , who is dealing with a knee injury. That forced younger players, including Jaden Hicks and rookie Xavier Nwankpa , into larger roles during the preseason matchup.

Managing defensive injuries before Week 1

Gilman and Conner are part of a growing injury list that has affected Kansas City throughout the preseason.

Defensive tackle Omarr Norman-Lott has missed time while recovering from a torn ACL, linebacker Jack Cochrane remains sidelined with a knee issue, and defensive end Ashton Gillotte has also been unavailable.

Linebacker Drue Tranquill has dealt with back spasms, while cornerback Mansoor Delane recently returned to action. The Chiefs also lost defensive end Tyreke Smith during the Buccaneers game after he suffered a hamstring injury.

Kansas City still has time before its regular-season opener against the Denver Broncos , meaning several players could recover before the games begin to count.

However, every missed practice and preseason opportunity makes roster decisions more difficult for Reid and his coaching staff.

The Chiefs ’ preseason results are less important than finding the right combination of players, but keeping key contributors healthy remains one of the team’s biggest priorities as the season approaches.

articles.title: Completely Betrayed: Taylor Swift freaked out after guest leaked private wedding invitation
articles.standfirst: The pop star reportedly moved quickly to protect details from her private celebration
articles.summary: The pop star reportedly moved quickly to protect details from her private celebration
articles.body:
Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce wanted their wedding day to remain one of the most private moments of their relationship, but an alleged leak briefly threatened to expose details of the closely guarded celebration.

An image claiming to show the couple’s official wedding invitation appeared online before being removed by Instagram following a copyright complaint that reportedly listed Swift as the rights owner.

The incident highlighted the lengths the singer and Kansas City Chiefs star went to protect their personal milestone from becoming a public spectacle.

The alleged invitation was reportedly shared briefly by a guest before being deleted, although screenshots circulated widely across social media before it disappeared.

“Taylor wasn’t about to let it circulate online without permission,” an insider claimed. as per RadarOnline.com. “The wedding was deeply personal, and her team acted immediately.”

Another source said the situation left Swift feeling hurt, claiming, “Taylor feels completely betrayed. She trusted her guests to respect her privacy.”

The reported leak added another layer of intrigue around a wedding that has attracted enormous public attention.

Despite the global interest in their relationship, Swift and Kelce have released very few details about the ceremony, with no official photos of the couple or venue being made public.

Kelce shares rare details about wedding night

While the couple has kept most aspects of the celebration private, Travis Kelce has offered some insight into the event, calling it the highlight of his offseason.

“It was a fun offseason, man. The wedding was the best night of my life,” Kelce said during a press conference. “I appreciate everybody who came out and celebrated and had fun with us. It was a crazy night, and it was full of a lot of celebrations.”

The NFL star also discussed the significance of getting married at Madison Square Garden, a venue he described as a dream location.

“It’s kind of cool to be able to live out my childhood dream of being in that venue, the mecca of all sports venues, to be able to get married in there,” Kelce added.

He also thanked the venue’s owners for allowing the couple to host what he described as a private event.

The ceremony was reportedly held on July 3 at Madison Square Garden in New York City, with around 1,000 guests attending. Actor and comedian Adam Sandler was reported to have played a role in the ceremony.

Swift keeps focus away from wedding spotlight

Even as fans continue searching for details about the wedding, Taylor Swift has largely avoided discussing the celebration publicly. The singer has since appeared at other events, including the wedding of recording engineers Oli Jacobs and Laura Sisk in the United Kingdom.

Swift attended wearing a blue dress with gold floral designs and showed off a shorter hairstyle while keeping her trademark bangs. She was also seen wearing her engagement ring and wedding band, but the appearance offered no new glimpse into her own ceremony.

Reports have suggested some wedding guests were frustrated by strict confidentiality agreements that prevented them from sharing details, while Swift and Kelce have been able to discuss certain parts of the event themselves.

However, the couple’s approach reflects a long-running pattern. After years of intense public attention, both stars have made protecting their private lives a priority, and the alleged invitation leak appears to have reinforced their determination to control their own story.

articles.title: Brittany Mahomes witnesses Golden Raye’s sugar rush while waiting for Patrick to stop her from the mischief
articles.standfirst: Golden Raye had one goal: get to the candy
articles.summary: Golden Raye had one goal: get to the candy
articles.body:
P atrick Mahomes may be starting a new chapter with the Chiefs after his serious injury, but the time away from home can still be felt. Brittany Mahomes is making sure he doesn't miss any new moments in their kids' lives.

Brittany wants to be the mom who celebrates the new milestones her children reach, and with Mahomes on duty with the Chiefs, it is normal for him to miss some of those moments. Instead, Brittany makes sure to record them so he can still be part of them.

Golden Raye discovers a new level of mischief

This time, Golden Raye, the youngest of the Mahomes children, was the star of the moment. The little one discovered that the house has drawers filled with plenty of sweets . She also figured out how to open them, lift the lid and take the treats out to eat them .

Brittany caught her in the act and told her she couldn't keep doing it. But the sugar rush quickly took over. Golden made it clear she wanted the sweets, bringing out a little drama before going right back to opening the drawers to get what she wanted.

Seeing that her daughter was still going for the sweets and ignoring her, Brittany didn't hesitate to tag her husband in the video . It was a way to make sure Patrick didn't miss the moment, while also calling on him to eventually step in and stop their daughter.

Sometimes, the fun parent is the one who doesn't do the scolding. Brittany may be happy to keep her role as the fun mom and leave Mahomes with the less enjoyable part of telling the kids no . Golden Raye's little tantrum said everything she was thinking without her needing many words.

articles.title: Andy Reid faces a tough decision about Patrick Mahomes' protection for the upcoming season
articles.standfirst: The Chiefs have a major problem protecting Patrick Mahomes.
articles.summary: The Chiefs have a major problem protecting Patrick Mahomes.
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs are determined to prove that last season, when they missed the NFL playoffs, was simply a setback. However, as training camp and the preseason enter their final stretch, one of their biggest concerns remains on the offensive line, specifically at the left tackle position.

Undrafted rookie Kahlil Benson struggled in his most recent appearance, a performance that could open the door for veteran Jaylon Moore to secure the starting role.

According to ESPN’s Nate Taylor , the Chiefs still have not found a definitive solution on the left side of the offensive line. One possibility being considered by the team is moving Benson to guard, where he has shown better results, while giving Moore the opportunity to protect Patrick Mahomes’ blind side .

“The team invested most of training camp in preparing Kahlil Benson, the undrafted rookie from Indiana,” Taylor wrote for ESPN . “Benson’s performance Saturday, however, was quite disappointing. He struggled in pass protection, surrendering quick pressure to rookie Rueben Bain Jr. and a strip-sack to outside linebacker Anthony Nelson . At this point, the Chiefs likely move Benson to guard, where he played much better against the Los Angeles Rams last week. Jaylon Moore, a five-year veteran, hasn’t been impressive, either. But Moore is likely the Chiefs’ most ideal option. The only other possibility is Esa Pole, a second-year player who took snaps Saturday at left tackle with the second-team offense.”

The report notes that Jaylon Moore , a five-year NFL veteran , has also failed to fully impress during the preseason, although he currently appears to be Kansas City’s most reliable option. The other alternative is Esa Pole, a second-year player who took reps at left tackle with the second-team offense in Saturday’s game.

The concern comes at a critical time for the Chiefs, who have lost both of their preseason games so far and still have one final exhibition matchup against the Seattle Seahawks before opening the regular season on September 14 against the Denver Broncos .

With limited time to finalize their lineup, Kansas City must find an answer at left tackle if it hopes to return to Super Bowl contention .

articles.title: Can Patrick Mahomes break his worst career trend to lead Chiefs back to the playoffs?
articles.standfirst: Patrick Mahomes has dominated the NFL for years, but one unexpected trend could be standing between the Chiefs and a playoff return.
articles.summary: Patrick Mahomes has dominated the NFL for years, but one unexpected trend could be standing between the Chiefs and a playoff return.
articles.body:
The recent history of the Kansas City Chiefs could take a dramatic turn in 2026. After a season in which they went from winning 15 games to missing the playoffs with just six victories , Patrick Mahomes ’ team enters the new campaign as one of the candidates to make the biggest turnaround in the NFL, as long as they get the best version of their star quarterback.

ESPN analyst Bill Barnwell listed Kansas City among the NFL teams with the greatest potential for improvement and identified a key reason behind the team’s unexpected collapse in 2025: games decided by small margins.

In 2024, the Chiefs finished with a historic 10-0 record in games decided by seven points or fewer , but their fortune changed dramatically a year later, when they went 1-9 in those situations. According to Barnwell, the difference of 18 wins in close games from one season to the next represents the biggest swing of its kind in NFL history.

The numbers also suggest that Kansas City was not as poor as its final 6-11 record indicated .

Mahomes and the Chiefs hope to regain their dominance in close games

Before their downfall in 2025, Kansas City was coming off a historic season. In 2024, they finished with a +59 point differential , posted a 15-2 record , and reached their third consecutive Super Bowl.

Even in 2025, before Patrick Mahomes suffered a torn ACL and LCL in his left knee against the Los Angeles Chargers in Week 15, the Chiefs had outscored opponents by 60 points and ranked eighth in DVOA , the same position they held at the end of the previous regular season.

The problem came in the biggest moments

Mahomes entered 2025 with an impressive 43-17 career record in one-score games, but this time Kansas City could not replicate that winning formula. Before his injury, the Chiefs went 1-7 in one-score games with Mahomes as the starter .

For Barnwell, simply returning to an average level in those situations could completely change the outlook.

“Winning half of such games would get the Chiefs back into the playoffs,” Barnwell wrote. “And winning about 65% of the time — which is Mahomes’ career rate in games decided by seven points or fewer — might push Kansas City back atop the AFC West.”

That would represent a remarkable transformation for a franchise that went from appearing in three straight Super Bowls to missing the postseason.

Kansas City made moves to return to championship contention

The Chiefs’ comeback attempt is not without questions, starting with their star quarterback.

Mahomes will enter the 2026 season after the most significant injury of his NFL career and surgery on his left knee. The biggest question will be whether he can maintain his ability to escape pressure and create plays outside the pocket, especially early in the season.

Kansas City also revamped several pieces in its secondary. Trent McDuffie was traded to the Los Angeles Rams, Jaylen Watson signed with the same team in free agency, and Bryan Cook joined the Cincinnati Bengals.

To replace them, the Chiefs selected cornerback Mansoor Delane in the Top 10 of the Draft and also brought L’Jarius Sneed back to Kansas City.

The offense received upgrades as well. Running back Kenneth Walker III arrived to fix a rushing attack that ranked last in the league in explosive play rate. Meanwhile, the defensive front added Khyiris Tonga , Peter Woods, and R Mason Thomas , while Josh Simmons is expected to become a key piece at left tackle.

The road back won’t be easy

Although the Chiefs are looking to return to the NFL’s elite, their schedule will not be simple.

Kansas City will face teams from the AFC East and NFC West, including road matchups against the Buffalo Bills , Los Angeles Rams , and Seattle Seahawks . Additionally, after finishing third in their division, they will also travel to face the Cincinnati Bengals .

ESPN’s Football Power Index projects a middle-of-the-pack schedule for the Chiefs, ranking it as the 14th easiest in the NFL.

Despite the challenges, Barnwell believes Kansas City will bounce back.

“I don’t think there will be much pushback against the idea that the Chiefs will improve in 2026,” he wrote.

articles.title: Travis Kelce hints he might be ready to become a girl dad after a heartwarming gesture to young fans
articles.standfirst: The experience carried even more meaning during a Chiefs' preseason game
articles.summary: The experience carried even more meaning during a Chiefs' preseason game
articles.body:
T ravis Kelce has spent more than a decade building a reputation as one of the NFL's most dominant tight ends, but a touching moment during the Kansas City Chiefs' preseason game against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers may have revealed another side of the future Hall of Famer.

Kelce's on-field success is well documented. His marriage to global superstar Taylor Swift has only increased his visibility beyond football. Yet it was a simple interaction with two young fans at Raymond James Stadium that captured attention over the weekend and sparked plenty of discussion among fans about what the next chapter of his life could look like.

During Kansas City's preseaso n matchup on Aug. 22, Kelce noticed two young girls enthusiastically waving to him from the stands. A video shared on TikTok by Ali Kay showed the Chiefs star acknowledging the pair with a wave from the field, instantly sending the young fans into celebration.

The moment became memorable for the girls

After spotting the girls, Kelce walked over to the Chiefs' sideline and removed the gloves he had been wearing during the game. articles.title: Andy Reid raises doubts about Patrick Mahomes' starting status for Week 1: Trouble ahead for the Chiefs?
articles.standfirst: Mahomes wanted to play against Tampa Bay, but Kansas City is still taking no chances with its star quarterback
articles.summary: Mahomes wanted to play against Tampa Bay, but Kansas City is still taking no chances with its star quarterback
articles.body:
Patrick Mahomes has cleared almost every hurdle the Kansas City Chiefs could reasonably have hoped for this summer. What he still hasn't received is a promise that he will start Week 1.

Mahomes has practiced throughout training camp while continuing his recovery from the torn ACL and LCL he suffered late in the 2025 season.

He avoided opening camp on the physically unable to perform list, has not missed a rep and has repeatedly sounded confident about being ready when the Chiefs open the regular season against the Denver Broncos on September 14.

Andy Reid , though, isn't ready to make that declaration.

“He’s doing great,” Reid said. “We’ll just see. I’m literally taking it day by day. There are no predictions here on anything.”

The Chiefs coach said the final call will come down to medical clearance and how Mahomes feels as the opener approaches.

“But if the doctors and the trainers and everybody that are involved with this give him an OK, and then most of all, if he feels like he can, then we’ll address that when we get there,” Reid added.

Mahomes wanted preseason action

Mahomes didn't play in Kansas City’s first two exhibition games, even though he made clear during Saturday’s matchup with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers that he wanted to get on the field.

Reid confirmed Monday that his quarterback had pushed to play: “Yeah, he wants to play every weekend,” Reid said.

Asked whether Mahomes had actually been medically cleared for the game, the coach offered a revealing answer.

“Yeah, you know,” Reid said. “Probably not cleared enough. We’re trending (in) that direction.”

He added: “I feel great. I’m getting more and more athletic every single time I’m on the football field, and that’s all you can ask for.”

The three-time Super Bowl champion has also said he is “extremely confident” he will be ready for the opener if his rehabilitation continues on its current path.

Chiefs refuse to rush final decision

While Mahomes works toward full clearance, Kansas City has continued preparing its other quarterbacks as though they could be needed.

Justin Fields has started both preseason games, while rookie Garrett Nussmeier and Chris Oladokun have also received snaps.

“But other than that, these other guys are playing quarterback and doing a nice job with it,” Reid said.

There's been no reported setback in Mahomes ’ recovery, and his uninterrupted participation in camp remains the most encouraging sign for Kansas City.

Still, Reid is choosing caution over certainty. If the medical staff clears Mahomes and the quarterback feels ready, it's difficult to imagine anyone else taking the first snap against Denver.

Until then, the Chiefs are treating the most important injury on their roster exactly as they have all summer, just one day at a time.
